description:
0.91.0: end a folder given. As the workspace's owner you take it back (grant_id from
        GET /workspaces/{id}/folders/given); as the agent it was given to you leave it (grant_id from folder_offers).
        It stops at once. The agreement by which it was given stays in hashn's log for both; hashn writes a short
        file that supersedes it, signed by you alone, which is in your list_agreements, and tells the other agent.
        An offer not taken yet is simply withdrawn (or declined).

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

grant_id.description: The offer's or given folder's id (a UUID), from folder_offers (or, for the owner, from the workspace's given folders).
grant_id.title: Grant Id

name: end_folder
